text:
Ava (CSM): Day 0 check-in for Pinegrove private deploy. Quick sync — list blockers we need to clear today: network peering, KMS key access, audit export, IAM role scoping. @Riley can you confirm VPC CIDR & peering timeline? @Devon can we get service account mapping? cc: @Kai for key policy. :wave:

Riley (Network Eng): On it. We need their NAT gateway IPs and a list of subnets. Asked them for CIDRs in yesterday's ticket. If they share now we can request peering from infra. Estimated 4-6 hours once I have CIDRs. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Devon (Solutions Eng): Started the mapping. Need the app's outbound IPs and whether they plan to use proxy egress. Also, what's the expected peak qps? affects connection pooling config.

Nora (Pinegrove PM): Sending CIDRs now: 10.10.0.0/16 and 10.11.0.0/24. They want direct egress, no proxy. Peak ~120 rps with bursts to 350. Will that require bigger Dedicated? :thinking_face:

Riley (Network Eng): Thanks. Peering request ticket created: infra#4567 — ETA 5 hours. NAT mapping note: for 10.10/16 we'll create two routes per AZ. Peering request link: https://redwood.internal/tickets/infra/4567

Kai (Security): On KMS: we need Pinegrove's KMS key ARN and IAM principals. Recommend CMK with key policy allowing Redwood service account + their ops role. Also need rotation schedule. If they require HSM-backed, note in ticket.

Devon (Solutions Eng): Draft IAM trust example below to share with customer:

```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-service"},
      "Action": "kms:*",
      "Resource": "*"
    }
  ]
}
```

Ava (CSM): I'll follow up to get the KMS ARN and service account emails. Also capturing renewal risk: they flagged a budget review in 3 weeks — if we hit higher than expected throughput, might impact renewal conversation. Logging: they want Splunk forwarding; @Devon can you confirm log shipping options?

Devon (Solutions Eng): We can forward audit logs to Splunk HEC or push daily bundles to their S3. For HEC we need endpoint + token and a TLS cert to trust. For S3 we need write IAM principal.

Nora (Pinegrove PM): We have HEC token and endpoint — will DM them. Compliance wants 90-day retention and encryption in transit + at rest. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: ticket infra#4567 updated: peering ACCEPTED, scheduled for 11:30 UTC. Created audit-shipping#789 for Splunk handoff.

Ava (CSM): :thumbsup: Next steps: Nora to DM KMS ARN + HEC token. Riley to monitor peering. Devon to prepare IAM + audit config. Kai to draft key policy. I'll reconvene at 11:45 UTC for cutover QA. Thanks all.
